criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

Draw browser -> name resolution -> connection -> server -> response -> browser rendering. Explain each arrow and distinguish transferred HTML from displayed pixels. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Break http://localhost:8000/products?low=1 into scheme, host, port, path and query in answers.md. Explain why localhost on a friend’s laptop is not your machine. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create public/index.html with an inventory heading and two products. From public run python -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1; open http://127.0.0.1:8000/ and record the response. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Use browser Network tools to record request URL, method, status and content type for index.html. Explain each field using the shop analogy. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Visit /missing.html and record the status. Compare a server returning an error response with stopping the server and getting a connection failure. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add a local HTML button that changes visible text with JavaScript. Observe whether clicking creates a network request. Explain where that change executes. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Draw React client, Django service and database with request/data arrows. Identify where stock is authoritative and why browser-visible stock can become stale. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
